title: error404.log.bin is byte-identical to boot.log.bin (same blob) despite 5x the ticks and diverging state
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/boot.log.bin b/goldens/boot.log.bin
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ccca1a9
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/boot.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/error404.log.bin b/goldens/error404.log.bin
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ccca1a9
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/error404.log.bin differ
detail: Both share blob ccca1a9 — error404's log is exactly boot's bytes. A demo named error404 with no error event logged (or a copied artifact) breaks the golden-log contract; hashes diverge after tick 50, so identical sims don't explain it.
recommended_fix: Regenerate error404.log.bin from the actual error404 run and confirm it records the 404 event; verify the golden pipeline writes per-demo logs rather than reusing boot's.

title: error404/08000ms.png is byte-identical to boot/01000ms.png (blob de0c242) while state hashes at those ticks differ
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/boot/01000ms.png b/goldens/boot/01000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..de0c242
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/boot/01000ms.png differ
diff --git a/goldens/error404/08000ms.png b/goldens/error404/08000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..de0c242
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/error404/08000ms.png differ
+10 bb97cb861d484654
+80 38539405d7a04cbf
detail: Identical PNG blobs at tick 10 (boot, bb97cb…) and tick 80 (error404, 385394…) — different hashed states, identical pixels. Either the screenshot was copied, or the render ignores the state the manifests hash. Both undermine determinism verification.
recommended_fix: Re-capture error404/08000ms.png from a fresh run; if the error404 screen genuinely matches boot's tick-10 frame, document why the visual state is hash-divergent but pixel-identical.

title: surge_basics has no .t1 manifest — the only demo in this chunk missing per-tick hashes
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/surge_basics.log.bin b/goldens/surge_basics.log.bin
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3b59807
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/surge_basics.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/surge_basics/305000ms.png b/goldens/surge_basics/305000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d481a5b
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/surge_basics/305000ms.png differ
detail: Every sibling demo (boot, draw_and_reject, draw_and_upgrade, error404, flow_basics, qos_dial) adds a .t1 manifest; surge_basics adds only .log.bin plus screenshots through 305000ms (≈3050 ticks at logic_hz 10). The longest demo is the only one unverifiable per-tick.
recommended_fix: Generate goldens/surge_basics.t1 with the same manifest format (seed 42, catalog_hash d8155971b81f86c0, ticks ≈3050) so its hashes can be verified like every other demo.

title: error404/40000ms.png (40s) exceeds the manifest's 250 ticks (25s at logic_hz 10)
evidence:
+ticks 250
diff --git a/goldens/error404/40000ms.png b/goldens/error404/40000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..986f8d9
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/error404/40000ms.png differ
detail: The manifest records ticks 1–250 (25s of sim at 10Hz), yet a screenshot is captured at 40000ms — 15s past sim end. Either captures run on wall-clock after the sim finishes (harmless but undocumented), or the timestamp/sim-length pairing is wrong.
recommended_fix: Capture error404 screenshots inside the sim window (e.g. 08000ms and 20000ms), or state the capture policy explicitly if post-end frames are intentional.

title: boot.t1's full 50-hash manifest is duplicated verbatim as error404.t1's first 50 ticks
detail: error404.t1 ticks 1–50 equal boot.t1's entire manifest (dce792328428e870 … 3e14cb47bcb6f5f1), same seed and catalog_hash. Consistent with a boot-replay demo, but worth confirming the duplication is scripted, not a stale header/tick-range copy.
recommended_fix: Confirm the error404 demo intentionally replays the boot script for its first 50 ticks; if so, add a comment or note in the manifest header documenting the shared prefix.
